text.title: Django Services Layer Procedure
text.summary: 8-step procedure applying the django-services methodology end-to-end. Each step lists inputs, action, output, and optional decision gate.

step.name: inventory-business-operations
step.action: List business-logic blocks and business operations (order_create, subscription_cancel, invoice_recompute); group by entity and record every caller of each.

step.name: group-by-aggregate
step.action: Group operations by aggregate and choose the module path — apps/<app>/services.py or app/services/<aggregate>.py. Never a module per caller type.

step.name: draft-service-signature
step.action: Write entity_action(*, kw, ...) -> ReturnType with full type hints; inputs are primitives, dataclasses or pydantic models, never a request or queryset.

step.name: move-logic
step.action: Move logic out of the view into the service body; replace any HttpRequest use with the primitive it needed; the view calls the service.

step.name: apply-atomic
step.action: If ≥2 writes that must succeed together, wrap in @transaction.atomic.

step.name: defer-side-effects
step.action: Replace direct task.delay()/webhook/email with transaction.on_commit dispatch.

step.name: write-service-test
step.action: Add unit tests calling the service directly (no Client) with pydantic/dataclass inputs and factory_boy fixtures, asserting model state + side-effect.
step.decision-gate: If a service is hard to test directly, its inputs are still leaking HTTP — refactor before continuing.

step.name: migrate-callers
step.action: Update every caller (view, admin, task, command) to invoke the service. Run import-linter to confirm no service imports django.http and no caller performs an ORM mutation.
